persona.label: CSM — cross-zone oversight + acting-scope backup
persona.frequency: acts as Zonal Manager backup whenever a ZM is unavailable (planned leave, marked-unavailable, or >24h heartbeat auto-activation) — per CONTEXT.md Decision §15 this can be several times a week across a CSM's zones, not an edge case

goals: Authenticate and hold a working session across a full day spanning own-scope and acting-scope work
Enter acting-scope for an unavailable Zonal Manager's zone with a visible, unambiguous indicator of which authority is live
Have every acting-scope action attributed (acted_as_role) so the audit trail and the %-of-approvals-by-backup report are trustworthy, then exit acting-scope cleanly
scopeNote: Module boundary spans two experientially distinct gates: CSM's mid-session role-switch (acting scope) and Ravi/SE's mobile day-start login. Persona picked = CSM because the taxonomy's P4 (separation-of-duties breach) and P2 (no audit) findings live specifically in the acting-scope mechanism, not in plain login. SE mobile login/session-expiry-mid-shift is real and in-scope per the module brief, but is a second persona's day — not scored under CSM's capability list here; S2 should still check mobile auth evidence.

capabilities.name: Credential login issues a session
capabilities.why: CSM cannot start own-zone or acting-scope work at all without authenticating first

capabilities.name: Session survives a full working day without silent logout
capabilities.why: a forced mid-acting-scope logout drops the covered ZM's zone context and stalls that zone's queue

capabilities.name: Enter acting-scope for an unavailable ZM's zone
capabilities.why: this is the backup cascade itself (CONTEXT §15) — without it a ZM absence blocks the whole zone's day, cascade has no bottom rung

capabilities.name: Persistent 'Acting as Zonal Manager for [Zone]' banner on every page
capabilities.why: without a visible indicator neither the CSM's own team nor an auditor can tell which authority is currently live — separation-of-duties breach risk (P4)

capabilities.name: acted_as_role stamped on every action taken while acting
capabilities.why: un-attributed acting-actions make the audit trail worthless — access control that cannot be audited is itself a finding (P2), not a lesser bug

capabilities.name: Clean, deliberate exit from acting-scope back to own role
capabilities.why: stale elevated access after the ZM returns is a standing separation-of-duties violation, not a one-time slip

capabilities.name: Role-scoped navigation shows only pages the active (or acted) role permits
capabilities.why: wrong-role page visibility is itself an access-control breach independent of whether backend guards also hold

capabilities.name: Auto-activation of acting-scope on ZM heartbeat absence >24h + up/down-layer notification
capabilities.why: without auto-activation an unnoticed ZM absence silently stalls the zone until someone manually escalates

capabilities.name: Login rate limiting / brute-force protection
capabilities.why: the credential store is the single gate for all five roles; an unthrottled login is an account-takeover exposure across the whole platform
